source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Find distance or time when speed and one other quantity are known.

intelligence.enrichment: Total distance covered = speed x total time taken, and total time taken = total distance covered divided by speed. Rearranging speed = distance divided by time lets the missing quantity be calculated from the two given quantities. The learner correctly applies this rule: Total distance covered = speed x total time taken, and total time taken = total distance covered divided by speed. Distance or time can be found by guessing whether to multiply or divide from the size of the numbers.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of time. The student must decide: Find distance or time when speed and one other quantity are known. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. Recalculate the key; do not copy source.key. Every option must be a claim that could answer the stem, and wrong options must be the same kind of answer as the key (a next term, a named process, or a row of the same shape). If the stem continues a number list, every option names a next term. Never write that naming or writing a term is what creates the list. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed int
